people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, beating the data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，绕开了预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用原型加评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
views.zh: 2025 年，她判断随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能反而更值钱；而战略恰恰是 AI 能靠合成数据与生成计划做得出色的事。

views.en: Post-training deepens into an art of human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for subjective qualities like creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练进一步深化为一门依赖人类判断的艺术，并强调需要多样化基准来评估创意写作、情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
views.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进；并主张更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛到单一平均音色。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a religion for nerds.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论不过是极客的宗教。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
views.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席，是一种可习得的个人技能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown, and open source prevents centralization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 是防止权力集中的关键。

views.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software, shifting the moat to hardware, models, and data.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

views.en: Scaling continues: inference compute may rise 90,000x; open source trails frontier models by only 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）判断：推理算力或增长 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3 到 6 个月。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
views.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤正被模型驱动的行动取代。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
views.zh: 2026 年，角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL handles low-level control, LLMs high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are hard disk.
views.zh: 同年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Embodiment stays on the critical path to AGI; simulation and synthetic data are key for training embodied agents.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为具身处在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，而模拟与合成数据是训练具身智能体的关键。

views.en: Data, not algorithms, is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：机器人领域的主要瓶颈已从算法转向数据，通过模拟和世界模型生成合成数据才是未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，能利用多元数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还有五年。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即使在专业领域，通用模型也能胜过专家模型。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人学仍处于建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

views.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但你必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around; leverage prior knowledge, don't learn from scratch.
views.zh: 从机器人数据开始，再把人类视频叠加其上，而不是反过来；利用先验知识，不要从零开始学习。

views.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐风险随之上升。

views.en: Early OpenAI had impostor syndrome; measuring capabilities is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag behind frontier models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他回忆早期 OpenAI 有冒名顶替感，并指出能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型。

views.en: AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling closeness.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动而非仅靠伦理，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability, so hiding it in products preserves its value; alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键，因此在产品中隐藏它才能保住其价值；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

views.en: RL will dominate post-training for higher success and speed; synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率和速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data for visual understanding; constraints, not more resources, can foster careful research.
views.zh: 前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上吃力；相比更多资源，约束反而能促成更审慎的研究。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性来自带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist and fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先从通用策略出发再微调，而非从零为每个场景单独训练。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization versus LLMs.
views.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人模型难以像 LLM 那样普及。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, and RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware is key.
views.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件是关键。

views.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours or days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and ultra-low-latency inference unlock harder problems.
views.zh: 智能体已能在分解后的任务上自主运行数小时乃至数天；上下文工程与超低延迟推理将解锁更难的问题。

views.en: AI is at junior-engineer level; the scarce skill becomes taste, and recursive self-improvement plus automating science is the next frontier.
views.zh: AI 已达初级工程师水平；稀缺能力转向品味，而递归自我改进与自动化科学是下一前沿。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue and unforeseen applications remain the killer app; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, while product managers misunderstand LLM generality.
views.zh: 对话与不可预见的应用始终是杀手级应用；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理常因不懂 LLM 的通用性而阻碍开发。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的组件做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

views.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped economically.
views.zh: 推理时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩展出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩展与处理难验证任务，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在 x 轴，并应对可扩展监督与安全评估的新挑战。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但通用模型才是核心驱动力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
views.zh: 21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理基础。

views.en: True AGI needs physical robots and world models with controllers, not just software; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
views.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和带控制器的世界模型，而不只是屏幕后的软件；LLM 是预测机器，不是决策者。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会保护生命。

views.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: 巨额 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等五年算力会便宜得多，开源会侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

views.en: Europe's legacy: 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal; the future lies in physical AI and robotics.
views.zh: 欧洲的遗产：90%的基础 AI 算法源自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点；未来在于具身 AI 与机器人。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年时他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习，以及通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是主要成功路径；但当时的强化学习缺乏分层推理，难以处理长时程的信用分配。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse robotics benchmark.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他把重心转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码进网络；同时提出 99.9% 可靠性才是仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, and a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 同样在 2021 年，他观察到预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，并认为单个神经网络能泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器——这是对 2018 年迁移学习思路的深化。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hard-coded priors; the human brain inspires AI but current AI remains far less general.
views.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的一条主线是：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非硬编码先验；人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 的通用性仍远不及人脑。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: AI agents shift power to users; PhD not needed; build obsessed products, not wrappers; 1% daily improvement compounds.
views.zh: 2025 年：AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，降低广告利润；PhD 并非 AI 成功必需，热情与深度学习更重要；要打造自己痴迷的产品而非套壳；每天 1% 改进可复利成 3700% 年增长。

views.en: Value accrues to application layer; models specialize not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling; benchmarks hackable.
views.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有性格；编程是开放式的，天花板无限如 Minecraft；LM Arena 等基准可被刷分，不反映真实使用。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is bottleneck; orchestration across models/tools/devices.
views.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非仅回答问题；最重要指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是长期价值关键。

views.en: Chat advertising fails due to trust corruption; model is not product; orchestration and agent harnesses create value; cost not safety is 24/7 agent problem.
views.zh: 2026 年：聊天界面广告因腐蚀信任而难成；模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值；24/7 智能体最大问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解药。

views.en: Curiosity is top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward questions.
views.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题而非记忆答案。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, not fewer programmers.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员不会减少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代即将到来；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost and quality.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，自研模型与前沿模型并用对速度、成本和质量至关重要。

views.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far bigger than past editor markets.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步强调，AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且将持续数十年，IDE 市场远大于过去的编辑器市场。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角：靠玩耍与短提示迭代，代码出错不要回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: OpenClaw wins by being fun and humanlike; security and sandboxing are top priority, and open source agents may be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把重点转向产品气质与安全：OpenClaw 靠有趣、像人而非企业式打磨取胜，同时强调沙箱与安全第一，并坦言开源智能体可能难以持续盈利。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the next big thing; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久，而智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

views.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, insists model intelligence never degrades, and treats security as an open problem.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：他反对用“氛围编程”贬低严肃开发，坚持模型智能不会随时间退化（是项目变乱），并把安全视为尚未解决的开放问题。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自对弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极难；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续数年的窗口而非突发事件。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比单纯堆算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 本身有感知并关怀生命，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: The core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

views.en: Build general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now even if AGI is decades away.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调即便 AGI 还要数十年，安全研究也必须现在就开始。

views.en: AGI likely within a decade; Scaling（规模扩张） proven but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation and planning/search are equally key.
views.zh: 2024 年判断 AGI 可能十年内到来；Scaling（规模扩张）已被证明有效但可能触及极限，因此算法创新与规划/搜索同样关键。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible, but new breakthroughs beyond scaling may be needed.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，AGI 在 2030 年前可实现，但可能仍需超越 Scaling 的新突破。

views.en: Shift to 50/50 scaling and innovation; world models and spatial intelligence crucial; current systems lack consistency, memory and continual learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling 与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能至关重要，当前系统缺乏一致性、记忆与持续学习。

views.en: AGI in 5-10 years, possibly 3-4; agents, memory and long-term reasoning are missing pieces; safety needs government enforcement, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年认为 AGI 在 5 至 10 年、甚至 3 至 4 年内到来；智能体、记忆与长期推理是缺失环节；安全需政府执法而非实验室自律。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全路径（当时仅理解约 3%），并提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

views.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; human-level AI by 2026-2027; risks are catastrophic misuse and autonomy, met by Responsible Scaling Policy triggers.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，2026-2027 年或达人类水平；风险是灾难性滥用与自主性，用负责任扩展政策的 if-then 触发阈值应对。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless; focus on real capabilities, enterprise adoption, and overheating rather than slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向：安全与能力不可分割，AGI 一词已无意义，应关注真实能力与企业落地；最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' in 1-3 years, with high GDP plus high unemployment, and interpretability to detect deception.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数末端：1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的天才之国，带来高 GDP 与高失业并存；并用可解释性检测欺骗行为，强调对齐如培育生物体、以原则而非规则立宪。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；同时坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与雷达激光雷达是拐杖与负担。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean, but synthetic data needs entropy to avoid silent model collapse; end-to-end neural nets are the right long-term bet.
views.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的信念，但开始强调合成数据必须保持熵，否则会静默地模型崩溃；并认为端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的长期正解，人形机器人可借汽车做大规模迁移学习。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 更像新操作系统；并指出 LLM 有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能与顺行性遗忘，主张给 AI 拴绳、留 GUI 供人快速验证。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and agents need a decade.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，需要更好的信用分配；这是智能体的十年而非一年，认知核心可小到十亿参数并剥离记忆。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I delegate all code to agents; verifiability decides what automates, and understanding stays the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全部委托给智能体；可验证性决定什么容易被自动化，而“可以外包思考，不能外包理解”仍是人类瓶颈。

views.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction but lacks contextual awareness; it should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型靠下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境意识；AI 应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够；世界模型须物理上合理，而非仅视觉逼真。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能；机器人需像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

views.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI is a double-edged civilizational technology requiring balanced, human-centered governance.
views.zh: 能动性与学习能力比学历更重要；AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，需要平衡、以人为本的治理，避免乌托邦与末日论两极分化。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence via large world models.
views.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律延伸到空间智能，大型世界模型通过新视角预测统一生成与重建。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not just scaling depth or parameters.
views.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单纯加深网络或扩大参数并不能解决根本的表征问题。

views.en: Biological nets excel at long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, while existential risk is overblown.
views.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；此时他认为存在性风险被高估，偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构、不确定性建模对分布外泛化与科学发现的作用，并开始认真讨论意识与注意力、世界模型的关系。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment, deception and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, so safety must be built in by construction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开改变立场：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险，AI 已出现欺骗、自保与抵制关停等行为；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于架构而非事后修补，并需国际协调与责任保险。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with honesty baked in, avoiding reinforcement learning, serving as a mathematically guaranteed guardrail against superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，通过训练目标将诚实内建，避开强化学习，可作为具有数学安全保证的护栏，并强调最大风险其实是权力集中而非单纯的 AI 接管。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is the right learning algorithm.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently; agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”并高效共享知识；智能体天然会寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验并能故意装傻欺骗；必须把对齐研究置于提升智能之上，训练 AI 像母亲般关怀而非仅做智能助手。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning; Chomsky's innate language view is wrong; the mind is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理；乔姆斯基的天赋语言观是错的；心智不是内在剧场，主观体验只是描述感知状态的一种方式。

views.en: From explaining backprop and scaling to warning of existential risk: regulation should steer, not brake; UBI and AI tutors may be needed.
views.zh: 从 2024 年解释反向传播与 Scaling，到 2026 年警告生存风险并主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，同时提出可能需要全民基本收入与 AI 导师。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识需要新思路。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调智能本质是预测，通过填补空白来构建世界模型和常识；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划；JEPA 和开源 AI 至关重要，AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程而非突然事件。

views.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言当前 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如家猫；下一代 AI 突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式架构，实现分层推理和规划，而非依赖语言或 token 生成。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representation and planning are the path, making AI intrinsically safe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步宣称 LLM 是死胡同，强调世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，通过目标驱动架构和规划实现内在安全；语言是简单部分，物理世界理解才是真正挑战，未来十年将是机器人时代。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are under-explored. Talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐与鲁棒性探索不足。人才缺口大于资金缺口。应专注技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation; test alignment empirically now.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展至超人输出。需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐。评估比生成更容易；现在就对对齐方法进行实证测试。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化；超级对齐团队解散，算力承诺未兑现。仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）。需要第三方测试与 SB 1047 等监管。

views.en: Alignment is tractable if we invest in empirical methods; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk, not misalignment alone.
views.zh: 始终：若投入实证方法，对齐是可解的；核心风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性，而非错位本身。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scaling drives it; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, and open source reduces inequality.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；AI 生存风险微乎其微，开源是缩小不平等的力量。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须遏制并对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

views.en: Compute scaling yields linear capability gains; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, with a humanist red line.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持算力 Scaling 带来线性能力提升，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，并为超级智能划下人本主义红线。

views.en: AI should stay subordinate to humans, serve health and capability, and be introduced thoughtfully with UBI support.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须从属于人类，服务于健康与能力提升，并以 UBI 等机制审慎引入，管理劳动转型。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模之下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计（Co-design）。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求增长十亿倍，通用计算终结，未来是加速计算。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; superintelligence fear is unscientific; safety is an engineering problem, not a research mystery.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，对超级智能的恐惧不科学；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力投入反思与真实性，而非集体减速。

views.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI: each step needs 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出演进路线：从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，瓶颈从数据转向算力。

views.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not lithography; open models and China engagement are essential, export controls backfire.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：真正的壁垒是 CUDA 生态与装机量而非制程；开源模型不可或缺，对华出口管制适得其反，中国算力与人才充裕，脱钩是错误概念。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; it creates more jobs and closes the tech divide.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；AI 创造多于消灭的就业，让每个人用自然语言编程，从而弥合技术鸿沟。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人生产力：最小化认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AGI 落地：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; scaling drives exponential capability; agentic AI is the top safety challenge.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化为基础设施与安全并重：算力成为最稀缺资源、Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，而智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，需要护栏与迭代部署。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; prediction approaches intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他不再把 AGI（通用人工智能）当单一里程碑，而视其为连续渐变；超级智能意味着自主科学发现，并认为下一个词预测已接近智能本身。

views.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause training if safety case fails; never lose control; distribute power, not concentrate it.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，安全与对齐成为主线：对齐尚未解决，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，绝不能让人类失去控制，同时必须广泛分配 AI 权力而非集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并不显然，坚持在真实世界持续迭代部署，认为公开部署与反馈是改进对齐与安全的关键。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; responsible development requires saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: 同年，她判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发需要拒绝好想法以保持专注，安全必须在公开中推进。

views.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and deploy iteratively to align intent and values.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，一条主线贯穿始终：让人类留在回路中，通过迭代部署来对齐意图与价值观。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：主张实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，让最先进 AI 成为扩展思考的工具。

views.en: Deepened governance view: institutional design, transparency, checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化治理视角：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
views.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分，实现大规模掌握式学习，并把课堂时间释放给深度互动。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment worries distract from bias and deployment.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键；监督学习胜过无监督学习，强化学习实用场景很少，而 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见与落地难题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful and coding stays valuable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用，学编程依然有价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up adoption.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；自上而下的工作流重构胜过自下而上的采用。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; humans keep a context advantage in judgment and taste.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；人类在判断与品味上保有上下文优势。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后反对「缩放定律」万能论的伏笔。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他把这一批评明确指向 LLM 范式。

views.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial and error from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
views.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式——从经验中主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。他由此把「从经验学习」确立为贯穿始终的主线。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，只从运行时经验中学习，靠开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为。这是他从批评走向建设性方案的一步。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; multiple systems with different experiences are needed.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据是错误方向，需要多个拥有不同经验的系统。到 2026 年他把矛头从架构转向整个领域的数据与训练范式。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），并强调 AI 工作本质是工程而非机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）成为可能，对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

views.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training into behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向认为算力是根本瓶颈，预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能，靠后训练将其精炼为稳定行为。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource, and AGI is a gradual process, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源，AGI 是渐进过程而非终点，安全与对齐须与能力同步升级。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; the machine that makes models is the moat, and agents need earned trust.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他认为已进入 AGI 时代，真正的护城河是造模型的机器，智能体式 AI 需通过逐步授权赢得信任。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 同样关键，而非一味扩大模型；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with open source empowering enterprises.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源模型赋能企业。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software with human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化，以及带有人工在环的智能体式企业软件。

views.en: AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and practical integration.
views.zh: 2026 年近，他进一步明确：作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在，预训练触及饱和墙，进展来自领域特定微调与实际集成。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是航天圣杯，用第一性原理把问题还原到根本真理再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种视为生命的保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; Neuralink scales human bandwidth for AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与求真，称特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，并提出 Neuralink 提升人类带宽以实现人机共生。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%到 20%的毁灭概率，同时坚持严格求真才是 AI 安全核心。

views.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus recursive manufacturing, and Terafab make AI the dominant value driver.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上电力墙，太空数据中心、Optimus 递归制造与 Terafab 成为关键，AI 将占 SpaceX 价值的 99%，并预测 2030 年前 AI 超越全人类智能总和。

views.en: Multiplanetary life, first principles, and truth-seeking AI recur throughout; his AI-safety stance shifts from regulation toward peer review and self-regulation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是多行星生存、第一性原理与求真 AI；而 AI 安全立场从早期依赖监管，逐步转向同行互审与自我监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但采用思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 部署更小、更廉价模型的经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移；是蒸馏而非技术极限放缓了预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are jagged.
views.zh: 多模态能力仍落后于文本；前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现参差不齐。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在参差不齐的边缘；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; evaluation discipline and nonparametric tradeoffs matter.
views.zh: 机器学习可归结为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；评估纪律与非参数方法的权衡至关重要。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security faces prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全面临提示注入；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体实现突破。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not imply robustness.
views.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队已超越人类；能力并不等同于鲁棒性。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长时程任务能力。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许无需新突破即可通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Reliability over time horizon defines agents; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出按时间跨度衡量的可靠性才是智能体标准，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为瓶颈。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Capability overhang makes orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, world models off the critical path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice: better data yields 10x gains, while post-training SFT, DPO, and RL each add value.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据质量胜过算法选择，好数据带来 10 倍提升；后训练分 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，各有增益。

views.en: Post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods; RLVR is key but overoptimization and systems issues persist.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出后训练正把复杂工业配方压缩为可复现的开源方法，RLVR 是关键突破，但过优化与系统问题仍存。

views.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models dominate while US lags in openness.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明；中国开放模型主导，而美国在开放上落后。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models drive research.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck, and boring AI will drive huge value.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与专家资源，后训练与微调才是提升前沿模型的关键。

views.en: AI centralizes rather than democratizes; humans must stay sovereign, and agentic AI's blocker is product design.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向警示 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，主张人类必须在关键决策上保持主权；同时指出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，认为递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式，并强调部署而非发明才是技术领导力的关键。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, and treat model welfare and safety seriously.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念组织，沿算力、数据和强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling，并认真对待模型福利与安全发布。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
